name: Sporobolus

project_scope.note: S. compositus completed review but remains a taxonomy/range HOLD because Central Texas material in the compositus complex is historically unstable. Genus-level processing is complete without installing it.

study_strategy.warning: The S. compositus complex is taxonomically messy in Central Texas. Do not promote a plant from the complex on habit alone; mature grain/pericarp, lemma characters, and reconciled specimen identity may be needed. Ambiguous Travis material is intentionally not counted as range evidence.

quick_split: S. clandestinus — perennial rough dropseed with contracted panicle.
S. vaginiflorus — small annual poverty dropseed with cleistogamous flowers hidden in upper sheaths.
S. compositus — robust perennial complex retained as HOLD pending cleaner local county/specimen resolution.

fast_fill_note: Sporobolus clandestinus and S. vaginiflorus each now have an exact-species public-domain diagnostic reference. Both remain presentation-source-limited pending easy rights-clear field photos; scientific status is unchanged.

source_concept_status.note: Williamson clear; ambiguous Travis material not counted.
